title: Deletion playback ledger and customer-initiated timeline reconciliation
creator: Jun Park
description: Build a verifiable, compact "deletion playback" ledger and a customer-facing timeline reconciliation flow to satisfy right-to-be-forgotten (RTBF) requests across Hosted and Dedicated deployments. The ledger should record immutable, signed checkpoints for tenant-scoped deletion events, support region-aware queries (to honor residency), and allow customers or auditors to fetch a paginated, tamper-evident timeline of actions taken for a given erasure request.
acceptance_criteria: Ledger persists deletion events with cryptographic hashes and signed checkpoints (KMS envelope) for each deletion batch
APIs: POST /rtbf/request to start; GET /rtbf/{request_id}/playback returns paginated timeline + cryptographic proofs
Playback respects tenant residency: queries from EU tenants only return EU-stamped events and metadata
Customer portal UI shows human-readable timeline, downloadable compact proof bundle (ZIP) with checksums and signature metadata
Retention: deletion events and proofs retained according to legal retention policy and per-tenant retention overrides
E2E test harness that replays sample deletion requests and verifies proof signatures and timeline integrity
success_metrics: Time-to-first-proof: median <= 60s from deletion completion to checkpoint availability
Customer verification success rate >= 99% for provided proof bundles in automated QA
Reduce manual audit requests by 80% in first quarter after rollout
No security incidents related to proof forgery or signature failures
implementation_notes: Prototype will use an append-only compact ledger stored as chunked files in object store with signed Merkle roots per chunk. KMS will envelope-sign chunk roots; HSM-backed stamping required for Dedicated and Private later. For Hosted launch, use Redwood KMS with rotation policy. Playback API should be paginated and eligible for caching of proof metadata to reduce recomputation. Integrate with existing deletion pipeline (ENG-29821) to emit deletions as events to the ledger writer service.
risks_mitigations: Ledger growth: mitigate with chunking + cold archival and compact checkpoint summaries
Residency leaks: enforce strict routing and tenant-scoped indexing; automated tests to assert region boundaries
Performance impact on deletion pipeline: introduce async checkpointing and backpressure isolation
Legal edge cases (legal hold): provide explicit flags and tie into Legal Hold service; ensure playback shows hold metadata
qa_plan: Unit tests for ledger writer, signer, and proof verifier
Integration tests: generate synthetic deletion requests across regions and verify timeline bundle integrity
Load test: simulate 10k deletion requests/day and measure checkpointing latency and storage growth
Security review and pen-test of proof bundle download flow
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (internal): deploy ledger writer to staging, run integration harness against staging delete pipeline
Phase 1 (beta): enable for selected tenants on Hosted (opt-in) + internal Dedicated tenants; gather feedback
Phase 2 (general): default-available for all Hosted tenants; Dedicated enablement via config
Phase 3 (follow-up): Private deployment packaging with HSM timestamping and air-gapped attestations
